title: Croatian Beef Skewers
description: Tender beef skewers marinated in a rich and flavorful Croatian-inspired sauce, perfect for a summer evening.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together the red wine, olive oil, paprika, garlic, salt, and black pepper.
Add the beef to the marinade and mix well to coat.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
Remove the beef from the marinade and thread onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes per side, or until the beef is cooked to your desired level of doneness.
Transfer the skewers to a plate and let rest for 5 minutes before serving.
